title: Town of Hartland fire August 25, 1980
description: Eleven firetrucks and as many as 75 firefighters from here and neighboring communities battled a massive blaze in the commercial section of Main Street for six and a half hours after it was discovered at 4 a.m., August 25, 1980. The fire began behind Stedmans and quickly swept down the street, leaping from roof to roof and tearing through firewalls as if they didn’t exist. Hartland Clothing, Wright and Everett, and the head office of Day & Ross were destroyed, while Never’s Pharmacy suffered extensive water damage, with the total losses estimated at $3 million. Onlookers watched in disbelief as history seemed to repeat itself: in 1907, the same commercial district burned in an eerily similar fashion on the same land. When our ancestors rebuilt with brick and firewalls, it proved no defence against the devastation.
